notes.title: PBR goes brrrr Update (v0.7.0)
notes.content:
[h1]Major changes in this one, not enough for a major update (aka game release)[/h1]
The day is getting closer and closer!
Not sure if it will be... soon though (sadly).

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
- Major material changes
- Changed some decals so they actually look good
- Added debris
- Replaced one animatronic, welcome Buster into this game now!
- Added basic save system
CAUTION: New Game will override all previous data (which is probably nothing if you haven't played this update yet)!
- New PBR materials
- New AI controller
- Minor bug fixes
- Changed 6AM text
- Added shift number functionality so that it actually changes
- (hopefully) Fixed animatronic animations
- Added the rest of the Story Mode button functionality
- Fixed something that caused minor lag
- Added framing to the Office window
- Added extra lights to some places in the building

Wow, that's the biggest changelog yet!
